question:
What is the difference between the total production of Cotton and Khadi?

Note: Ignore negative signs, if any.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 8.

Given that

The total production of Cotton of all companies = 114 + 120 + 121 = 355

question_hi:

solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 8 है।

दिया गया हैं कि

सभी कंपनियों का कपास का कुल उत्पादन = 114 + 120 + 121 = 355

question: The following figure shows the percentage growth in units of fans and coolers sold in some years. What is the difference between the averages of the growth rate in coolers and fans?
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 34.

Given that

The total growth rate in sales of coolers = 60 + 72 + 54 + 45 = 231

The average growth rate in sales of coolers = 231/4 

The total growth rate in sales of fans = 27 + 18 + 30 + 20 = 95

The average growth rate in sales of fans = 95/4

Hence, The required difference = 231/4 - 95/4 = 136/4 = 34
question_hi: दी गई आकृति कुछ वर्षों में बेचे गए पंखों और कूलरों की इकाइयों में प्रतिशत वृद्धि दर्शाता है। कूलरों और पंखों में वृद्धि दर के औसत के बीच क्या अंतर है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् 34 है।

दिया गया हैं कि

कूलर की बिक्री में कुल वृद्धि दर = 60 + 72 + 54 + 45 = 231

कूलर की बिक्री में औसत वृद्धि दर = 231/4

पंखों की बिक्री में कुल वृद्धि दर = 27 + 18 + 30 + 20 = 95

पंखों की बिक्री में औसत वृद्धि दर = 95/4

अतः, अभीष्ट अंतर = 231/4 - 95/4 = 136/4 = 34

question:
The following bar graph shows the number of students who opted for different subjects in 2020 and 2021.

Out of all 5 subjects, what percentage (rounded up to two decimals) of students opted for Biology in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 21.18%.

The number of students of biology in 2021 = 90

The total number of students of all subjects in 2021 = 85 + 90 + 65 + 110 + 75 = 425

Hence, the required percentage = (90/425) × 100 = 21.18%

सभी 5 विषयों में से, 2021 में कितने प्रतिशत (दशमलव दो स्थान तक पूर्णांकित) छात्रों ने जीव विज्ञान को चुना?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 21.18% है।

2021 में जीव विज्ञान के छात्रों की संख्या = 90

2021 में सभी विषयों के छात्रों की कुल संख्या = 85 + 90 + 65 + 110 + 75 = 425

अतः, अभीष्ट प्रतिशत = (90/425) × 100 = 21.18%

question:
The following pie chart shows the population of seven districts of the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

If the total population of the seven districts is 150 crore, find the total population of A and D.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 45 Crore.

The total population of the seven districts = 150 crore

The percentage population of A = 13%

The percentage population of D = 17%

The total population of A and D = (13 + 17) × 150/100 = 45 crore

यदि सात जिलों की कुल जनसंख्या 150 करोड़ है, तो A और D की कुल जनसंख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् 45 करोड़ है।

सात जिलों की कुल जनसंख्या = 150 करोड़

A की प्रतिशत जनसंख्या = 13%

D की प्रतिशत जनसंख्या = 17%

A और D की कुल जनसंख्या = (13 + 17) × 150/100 = 45 करोड़

question: The following pie chart shows the annual expenditure on different items. What is the minimum angle in the given pie chart?
solution:

Total central angle = 360º

⇒ 100% = 360º

⇒ 10% = 360º × 1/10 = 36º

आवास रखरखाव या मनोरंजन पर वार्षिक व्यय का न्यूनतम प्रतिशत = 10%

प्रश्न के अनुसार

⇒ 100% = 360º

⇒ 10% = 360º × 1/10 = 36º

अतः न्यूनतम कोण 36º है।

If the number of students in IIT Bombay is 20% less than the number of students in IIT Madras, then what is the difference between the total number of students who study in the Applied department in these two colleges and that of the students who study in the Civil department in these two colleges?
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 106.

Let's assume the total number of students in IIT Madras = 100x

So, the total number of students at IIT Bombay = 100x × (100 - 20)/100 = 80x

Total students = 2080

Total students in IIT Delhi, Kanpur and Guwahati = 430 + 350 + 400 = 1180

Students in IIT Bombay and Madras = 2080 - 1180 = 900

⇒ 100x + 80x = 900

⇒ x = 5

The total number of students at IIT Bombay = 80x = 400

The total number of students at IIT Madras = 100x = 500

The total number of students who study in the Applied department in these two colleges = 400 × 32/100 + 500 × 35/100 = 303

The total number of students who study in the Civil department in these two colleges =  400 × 18/100 + 500 × 25/100 = 197

Required difference = 303 - 197 = 106

question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie-chart displays the percentage of fruits sold (in kg) by a fruit seller in one month.

If the total number of fruits sold by a fruit seller in one month was 50,000 kg, find the approximate difference between the quantity (in kg) of Grapes and that of oranges.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 11,480.

Given that

If the total fruits sold by a fruit seller in one month was 50,000 kg

Calculation

The quantity (in kg) of Grapes = 50000 × 31.07% 

The quantity (in kg) of orange = 8.11% × 50000 

Hence, the required value = (31.07 - 8.11) × 50000  = 11480

यदि एक फल विक्रेता द्वारा एक महीने में बेचे गए कुल फल 50,000 किलोग्राम थे, तो अंगूर और संतरे की मात्रा (किग्रा में) का अनुमानित अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् 11,480 है।

दिया गया है   

यदि एक फल विक्रेता द्वारा एक महीने में बेचे गए कुल फल 50,000 किलोग्राम थे

गणना

अंगूर की मात्रा (किलो में) = 50000 × 31.07%

अतः, अभीष्ट मान = (31.07 - 8.11) × 50000  = 11480

question: The following bar graph shows the rainfall over two years. Which of the following months shows the highest percentage change in rainfall?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. March.

Percentage change in January = (55 - 35)/35 × 100 = 57.14%

Percentage change in March = (45 - 25)/25 × 100 = 80%

Percentage change in May = (75 - 45)/75 × 100 = 40%

Percentage change in July = (35 - 20)/35 × 100 = 42.85%

Percentage change in September = (25 - 15)/25 × 100 = 40%

Percentage change in November = (55 - 35)/35 × 100 = 57.14%

Thus, the height percentage changed in rainfall in March.
question_hi: निम्नलिखित बार ग्राफ दो वर्षों में हुई वर्षा को दर्शाता है। निम्नलिखित में से किस महीने में वर्षा में सबसे अधिक प्रतिशत परिवर्तन हुआ है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात् मार्च है।

जनवरी में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = (55 - 35)/35 × 100 = 57.14%

मार्च में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = (45 - 25)/25× 100 = 80%

मई में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = (75 - 45)/75 × 100 = 40%

जुलाई में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = (35 - 20)/35 × 100 = 42.85%

सितंबर में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = (25 - 15)/25 × 100 = 40%

नवंबर में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = (55 - 35)/35 × 100 = 57.14%

इस प्रकार, मार्च में वर्षा में सबसे अधिक प्रतिशत में परिवर्तन होता है।

question:
Study the given pie chart carefully and answer the following question.

What is the difference between the funds (in Rs.) acquired by the school from donations and those from government agencies?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 2,30,000.

Funds from Donations = (35/100) × 10,00,000 = Rs. 3,50,000

Funds from Government Agencies = (12/100) × 10,00,000 = Rs. 1,20,000

Difference = Funds from Donations - Funds from Government Agencies Difference

⇒ Rs. 3,50,000 - Rs. 1,20,000 = Rs. 2,30,000
question_hi:

स्कूल द्वारा दान से अर्जित धन और सरकारी एजेंसियों से प्राप्त धनराशि (रुपये में) के बीच का अंतर क्या है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् 2,30,000 है।

दान से प्राप्त धनराशि = (35/100) × 10,00,000 = 3,50,000 रुपये

सरकारी एजेंसियों से धनराशि = (12/100) × 10,00,000 = 1,20,000 रुपये

अंतर = दान से धन - सरकारी एजेंसियों से धन अंतर

⇒ 3,50,000 रुपये - 1,20,000 रुपये = 2,30,000 रुपये
